description.value: A free riverside recreation site with 9 tent pitches, tables, and fire rings on the Squamish River near Ashlu Creek, popular for fishing; the last ~1 km of approach is unpaved dirt road, there is no treated water or garbage service, and bear activity plus flood risk during heavy rain are noted.

raw_osm.description: The Squamish Riverside Recreation "Rec" Site (REC0265) sites right next to the river. It has nine tent areas with many tables and fire rings. The entire site shares two outhouses.
raw_osm.name: Squamish Riverside Recreation Site
raw_osm.note: This site will close due when black and grizzly bears are seen in the area. See the website for its current status. Store food items in vehicles and pack out all garbage and refuse as there is no garbage pick-up service, and therefore no camping fees at
raw_osm.source: BC Open Data Catalogue - Recreation Polygon

wow_evidence: 9 tent pitches, tables, and fire rings on the Squamish River
